chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Hilāl, from his father, from Abū al-Safātij, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام concerning the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
All praise is due to Allah, Who guided us to this, and we would not have been guided had Allah not guided us.
So he said: When it is the Day of Qiyamah, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and Amīr al-Muʾminīn and the Imams from his offspring عليهم السلام will be called, and they will be set up for the people.
Then when their Shiʿah see them, they will say: All praise is due to Allah, Who guided us to this, and we would not have been guided had Allah not guided us.
Meaning: Allah guided us to the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn and the Imams from his offspring عليهم السلام.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams, the divinely designated leaders from his offspring عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: praise and gratitude offered to Allah
key_terms.شِيعَتُهُمْ: their Shiʿah; the devoted followers of the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.هَدَانَا: guided us; directed us by divine guidance
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ: wilayah; divinely appointed authority and allegiance
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret “All praise is due to Allah Who guided us to this” in relation to the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Quranic praise of divine guidance as referring, in this context, to guidance toward the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn and the Imams عليهم السلام. It depicts the Day of Qiyamah, when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and the Imams عليهم السلام are presented before the people, and their Shiʿah recognize this guidance with gratitude to Allah.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Hilal, from his father, from Abu Al Saffatij, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Majestic and Mighty
[7:43] All Praise is due to Allah Who Guided us to this, and we would not have found the Way had it not been that Allah had Guided us.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it will be the Day of Judgment. They would call the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> and the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from his<sup>asws</sup> sons<sup>asws</sup>, so they<sup>asws</sup> would be established for the people.
So when theiras Shias see themasws, they would be saying [7:43] All Praise is due to Allah Who Guided us to this, and we would not have found the Way had it not been that Allah had Guided us
- meaning Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Guided us regarding the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> and the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from his<sup>asws</sup> sons<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 33. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Urama and Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah from Ali ibn Hassa’nfm ‘Abdallah ibn Kathir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious.
“What do they quarrel about? [78:1]. They quarrel about the great news.” [78:2]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “The great news here stands for Leadership with Divine Authority.” I asked him about the meaning of, “. . in such helplessness, the human being realizes that it is God who is the true Guardian . .” [18:44]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to the guardianship and Leadership with Divine Authority of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.)).”
